youtube.title: WEDNESDAY WEBINARS
youtube.summary: Simon O’Connor, Rodney Hide and Bob McCoskrie explain how New Zealand’s MMP voting system works ahead of the general election, examining wasted votes, electorate overhangs and strategic voting. They discuss how polling could affect National, ACT, New Zealand First and other parties, and why voters should understand the implications of their party and electorate votes while ultimately making their own choices based on their values. For election news that matters, get RCR Bites FREE every weekday and find out everything about the overhang and tactical voting at Vote Smart For other relevant RCR content check out: More of our RCR Election 2026 content Last week's Wednesday Webinar | Politics – A Rural View: Don Nicolson and Jaspreet Boparai A Political Agenda with Bob McCoskrie & Maurice Williamson | Strategic Voting – Why This Election Is Different Winston Peters | Peters Sets Out Growth Vision Paul Henry | ACT’s Plan to Overhaul Superannuation and KiwiSaver

youtube.title: PETER JAMES STEVEN
youtube.summary: Rodney Hide speaks with Wellington-based developer Peter James Steven, creator of Detrans.ai, an AI tool designed to make detransitioners’ experiences more accessible. Steven explains how his sister’s transition prompted him to investigate the subject and build a platform drawing on accounts shared online. They discuss the challenges of finding balanced information, the social consequences of questioning prevailing views and AI’s potential to help people explore sensitive personal issues. For more information: Check out Detrans Ai Genspect NZ Conference 2026 | Saturday 17th October, Wellington Find Peter James Steven on X

youtube.title: LEGAL HUB
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan is rejoined by Katie Ashby-Koppens for a Legal Hub on encouraging New Zealanders overseas to vote in the upcoming election, with only a small proportion currently registered. They also discuss New Zealand’s abstention from a non-binding UN pandemic declaration and the ongoing negotiations over the World Health Organization’s pandemic agreement, including concerns about national sovereignty and pathogen-sharing arrangements. For election news that matters, get RCR Bites FREE every weekday and find out everything about the overhang, wasted vote and tactical voting at Vote Smart

youtube.title: MONEY TALKS
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan speaks with Farzin Irani of Sovereignty Capital about his concerns over a potential global debt crisis, rising interest rates and inflation, and the risks facing government finances and household wealth. They discuss political promises ahead of New Zealand’s election, housing trends, fuel taxes and international tensions. Irani also outlines his upcoming Auckland event, Capital Intelligence, focused on how capital moves during periods of panic and how people can protect their assets. DISCLAIMER: The views and information shared on this show are for educational and informational purposes only. They do not constitute personalised financial, investment, tax, or legal advice. Listeners should seek guidance from a licensed financial professional who can provide advice based on their individual situation. Don't miss Farzin's upcoming one day event in Auckland on Saturday 28 November Check out his new website Sovereignty.capital – with free resources to help people prepare for the future.

youtube.title: RIDING SHOTGUN
youtube.summary: Rachel Stewart examines the coordinated global protests marking October 7, arguing that mainstream media downplays the hostility and political agendas behind them. She explores the organisation and funding behind protests in France, alleging links between established political groups and international far-left networks and draws parallels with unrest in the US and pro-Palestinian demonstrations across the West. Discover more from Rachel on Substack and X

youtube.title: RCR Wednesday Webinars - Politics
youtube.summary: With the 2026 General Election approaching, join RCR hosts Simon O’Connor (former National MP) and Rodney Hide (former ACT leader), alongside Family First founder Bob McCoskrie, for a practical discussion about voting, values and strategy. How does your vote really work under MMP? They’ll cover the two ticks, the 5% threshold, electorate seats, overhangs, wasted votes and strategic voting. Simon introduces RCR’s Vote Smart 2026 initiative, including election explainers and a nationwide flyer campaign. Bob shares Family First’s Value Your Vote 2026 voter guide, comparing parties on the issues that matter.
